_doc: Central vocabulary for stage ו of docs/PLAN-PRODUCT-TRUTH.md: words a product's OWN name uses to say what kind of thing it is, independent of any single concept. Used by matchingConcepts (src/catalog/concepts.js) as a gate before a concept's own match.none: a `fresh` concept never matches a name carrying a `processed` word (unless the concept's own match.all contains that word - a concept literally about pickles still needs 'כבוש'), and a `processed` concept never matches a name whose ONLY evidence is a `fresh` word. `any` concepts (herbs sold both fresh and dried, flavour-identity drinks) skip both checks. Patterns are regex fragments on normalizeText output (src/catalog/matching.js): no niqqud, final letters ך ם ן ף ץ mapped to כ מ נ פ צ (a pattern with a final letter can never match - loadTypeWords enforces this the same way loadConcepts does), single spaces. Brand words (מימון, קראנץ, פרג, קנור, אוליבי, גאמפ, אקטיביה...) stay per-concept in match.none - a brand is not a type, and the same brand sells both fresh and processed lines depending on category. Seeded from the 23.9 cross-check spec (docs/PLAN-PRODUCT-TRUTH.md §3.2, §3.6) and from the per-concept match.none lists that repeated the same ~230-entry block across all 45 fresh-produce concepts before this file existed (scripts/concept-dead-rules.mjs pruned the entries this file made redundant).
_doc_pet: Marks a product as food or goods FOR an animal. matchingConcepts tests a name against this list ONCE, and then no concept outside בעלי חיים may match it; categorize() sends such a name to בעלי חיים. Replaces 3,683 copies of a similar list that had been pasted into the `none` of 203 concepts and had drifted - the kitten forms were missing from all of them until 25.9, so a kitten tuna pate sold as human tuna. Applying ONE list to all 724 concepts instead of 203 exposed collisions the copies had never been tested against, so every entry is bound to the form the word takes on a pet product, measured over every raw name on 27.9: the bare species words are gone ('לשונות חתול' is a biscuit, 'חתול שמן' a beer, 'בצק משחק כלב' a toy) and only 'for a X' / 'X-s' / kitten remain; 'פנסי' only as Fancy Feast in its three spellings (paprika is 'אקסטרה פנסי'); 'פיין' only as Fine Cat / Fine Dog (coffee and salami are 'פיין'); 'פרמיו' only at the start (a trailing 'פרמיו' is a truncated 'פרמיום'); 'בונזו' with no letter after (the Bonjour bakery normalizes to 'בונזור'). 'פרגי' is deliberately absent although two concepts carried it: it heads 'פרגית', chicken thigh, on 181 real names.
_doc_fresh: Only 'טרי' is evidence that a product is fresh. Until 27.9 this list also carried ארוז (packaged), תפזורת (loose) and במשקל (sold by weight), and because a `processed` concept is blocked when a name's only type-word is a fresh one, every processed concept was silently refused on anything sold packaged or by weight: cashews, almonds, walnuts and pistachios 'במשקל' matched nothing, and so did deli meats and cheeses sold by the kilo. Those three words describe how a thing is sold, not whether it is fresh. Two rounds found this on the same day from opposite ends of the catalogue and each worked around it by marking ~140 concepts `kind: any`; the fix belongs here. Those `any` markings are left in place - they are harmless, and each was measured when made.
_doc_vegan: Naor, 28.9: a vegan product is a product of its own, even when it is sold as a substitute. A name carrying one of `vegan` (explicit vegan wording and the vegan brands, never the bare "צמחי" - "טונה בשמן צמחי" is real tuna - and never the bare "תחליף", which is also baby formula and sweetener) matches no concept in `veganScope`: the animal-product categories plus the named animal concepts elsewhere, minus the plant-based concepts those categories hold. Tested once per name in matchingConcepts (src/catalog/concepts.js), like `pet`.
_doc_frozenTwins: Naor, 28.9: fresh and frozen (and thawed, מופשר) meat, poultry and fish are two products. Each concept listed here refuses `word`, and scripts/frozen-twins.mjs writes its `<id>-frozen` twin (the same rules plus `word`) to meat-fish-frozen.json. Not listed: products that come in one form only (sausages, nuggets, pâté, kreplach, dried fish) and salmon, whose frozen side already is salmon-frozen. `word` also reads a name cut off mid-word ("פילה סלמון נורווגי ק", "נסיכת הנילוס קפ" - every such meat or fish row in the files is frozen, except a kilo after a number, "1.2 ק", and a chilled "מצונן ק") and ice-glazed fish ("מכיל 80% דג", "מצופה קרח"). A size grade on a fish fillet ("5-7", "7-9") is the frozen product too: Carrefour sells "פילה אמנון 5-7 קפוא" and "5-7 בד\"צ" at the same 33.90.
